NTEMS species-weighted gross stem volume

Source: R/host-volume.R
ntems_species_volume.Rd

Derive a species-group volume raster (m3/ha) from two NTEMS products: gross stem volume (2022) multiplied by the summed per-species likelihood share of the canopy (2019). No post-2014 product distributes species-specific volume directly, so this reconstructs it as volume * (sum of species likelihoods) / 100.

Usage

ntems_species_volume(
  species,
  study_area = NULL,
  dest_dir = NULL,
  spp_year = 2019L
)

Arguments

species

character vector of NTEMS species codes whose likelihoods are summed, e.g. c("POPU.TRE", "POPU.BAL", "POPU.GRA") for Populus.

study_area

(optional) SpatVector (or sf) to crop and mask to.

dest_dir

character, destination directory for downloads (defaults to a subdirectory of tempdir()).

spp_year

integer, the species-probabilities epoch (default 2019).

Value

SpatRaster of species-weighted gross stem volume (m3/ha).

Details

Only the requested species layers are extracted from the ~21 GB species probabilities archive (via workflowtools::archive_extract_once, which falls back to the system unzip for ZIP64), and rasters are read lazily; when study_area is supplied only that window is read. Rasters are never reprojected – the study-area vector is reprojected to the raster CRS.
